incidents.title: مجلس التطوير المؤسسي يستعرض مستجدات العمل والمشاريع التطويرية Institutional Development Council Convenes to Review Progress and Development Initiatives ترأس اللواء الركن خليفة حارب الخييلي، وكيل وزارة الداخلية، الاجتماع الثالث لمجلس التطوير المؤسسي لعام (2026)، بحضور أعضاء المجلس وعدد من الضباط، وذلك في قاعة الاتحاد بمقر الوزارة. واستعرض الاجتماع مستجدات الأعمال، وأبرز المبادرات والمشاريع التطويرية، إلى جانب مناقشة المهام والأجندة المدرجة ضمن خطط العمل، بهدف رفع كفاءة التنفيذ، والارتقاء بالأداء المؤسسي، ودعم تحقيق الأهداف الإستراتيجية للوزارة. كما بحث أعضاء المجلس سبل تعزيز الجاهزية والاستعداد، وتطوير المنظومة الأمنية، بما يرسخ الأمن والاستقرار، ويسهم في الارتقاء بجودة الحياة في المجتمع. Major General Khalifa Hareb Al Khaili, Undersecretary of the Ministry of Interior, chaired the third meeting of the Institutional Development Council for 2026 at the Union Hall in the Ministry's headquarters, in the presence of council members and a number of officers. The meeting covered work updates, key initiatives, and ongoing development projects, with discussions centered on tasks and agenda items outlined in the work plans, all aimed at improving implementation efficiency, strengthening institutional performance, and advancing the Ministry's strategic objectives Members also explored ways to step up readiness and preparedness and develop the security system, in support of consolidating security and stability and enhancing quality of life across society #وزارة_الداخلية_الإمارات #فخورين_بالإمارات 🇦🇪 #الامارات_أمن_وأمان #MOIUAE

Every week, trucks of medical aid enter the Gaza Strip to ensure the appropriate medical response is available for the Gazan civilian population. Since the start of the ceasefire, approximately 18,000 tons of medical supplies have entered Gaza, coordinated according to requests from the UN and international organizations, reaching the dozens of operating hospitals, clinics, and medical centers and facilities operated by the international community. Among the medical supplies that enter are ultrasound machines, blood testing devices, first-aid kits, medical laboratory equipment, hospital beds, and X-ray machines. COGAT remains committed to working together with its international partners to advance the humanitarian situation in Gaza and coordinate needs-based solutions on the ground.

Through its Law Respect Culture Bureau and in partnership with Abu Dhabi Councils at the Office of Citizens and Community Affairs in the Presidential Court, the Ministry of Interior organized an educational council entitled "The Balance of Emirati Identity" at the Al-Tuwayya Council in Al Ain. The initiative aimed to strengthen national identity and reinforce authentic Emirati values across society. The council centred on the theme "Balancing National Values and Scientific Development," exploring the importance of upholding Emirati identity and national values while embracing scientific progress.
